parts:
Dear Karl
I have an F5 bi-parental population consisting of 72 lines. Kindly advice if I can carry out qtl mapping on this population

messages.author: 04e62c3b36bb17bf
messages.subject: Re: Population size for qtl mapping in Wheat
parts:
Conceptually, it won't be a problem. But, you will not be able to detect small effect QTL. 
Check out the R/qtlDesign package https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/qtlDesign/index.html to see what kind of power you might have.
Good luck,
John
